descriptionInUI: Removes AI aircraft from carrier and ship decks a set time after they land, so a jet stuck in the wires or parked in the landing area can't block everyone behind it. Players are never removed. Removed aircraft are not counted as losses: they go back to their squadron as normal.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Remove AI from the deck after n seconds
Also remove AI stuck on the deck without a landing report
Show a message when an aircraft is removed
